function object({flag = true, text = 'text'}) {
  const bool: boolean = flag;
  const stringValue: string = text;
  console.log(bool, stringValue);
}
object({});
object({flag: false, text: 'other'});
function tuple([value = 2]) {
  const numberValue: number = value;
  console.log(numberValue);
}
tuple([]);
tuple([5]);
function nested({outer: {key = 3}, inherited: {numberValue} = {numberValue: 4}}) {
  const a: number = key;
  const b: number = numberValue;
  console.log(a, b);
}
nested({outer: {}});
function extra({x = 1, ...rest}) { console.log(x, rest.other); }
extra({other: 6});
function empty([]) { console.log('empty'); }
empty('iterable');
function onlyRest([...args]) { console.log(args.length); }
onlyRest([1, 2]);
function restTuple(...[value = 7]) { console.log(value); }
restTuple();
restTuple(8);
const computed = Symbol();
function withComputed({[computed]: value = 9}) { console.log(value); }
withComputed({});
withComputed({[computed]: 10});
const contextual: (p: {a?: number; b?: number}) => number = ({a = 11, b = a}) => b;
console.log(contextual({}));

function first({x:{a=1}={}}){const y:number=a; console.log(y);}
first({}); first({x:{}}); first({x:{a:2}});
function second({x:{a=1}={a:2}}){const y:number=a; console.log(y);}
second({}); second({x:{}}); second({x:{a:2}});
function deep({x:{child:{a=1}}={child:{}}}){const y:number=a; console.log(y);}
deep({}); deep({x:{child:{}}}); deep({x:{child:{a:2}}});
function arrays({x:[a=1]=[]}){const y:number=a; console.log(y);}
arrays({}); arrays({x:[]}); arrays({x:[2]});
function reversed([{a=1} = {}]){const y:number=a; console.log(y);}
reversed([]); reversed([{}]); reversed([{a:2}]);
const nestedKey = 'a';
function named({x:{[nestedKey]: a=1}={}}){const y:number=a;console.log(y);}
named({}); named({x:{a:2}});
const numericKey = 2;
function indexed({x:{[numericKey]: a=1}={}}){const y:number=a;console.log(y);}
indexed({}); indexed({x:{2:2}});
const nestedSymbol = Symbol();
function symbolKey({x:{[nestedSymbol]: a=1}={}}){const y:number=a;console.log(y);}
symbolKey({}); symbolKey({x:{[nestedSymbol]:2}});
function deepKey({x:{child:{[nestedKey]: a=1}}={child:{}}}){const y:number=a;console.log(y);}
deepKey({}); deepKey({x:{child:{a:2}}});
function explicitTuple({x:{value:[n=1]}={value:[]}}) { console.log(n); }
explicitTuple({});
explicitTuple({x:{value:[]}});
function explicitArrayElement({x:[[n=2]]=[[]]}) { console.log(n); }
explicitArrayElement({x:[[]]});
function directTupleDefault({x:[n=1,m=2]=[3]}) { console.log(n, m); }
directTupleDefault({});
directTupleDefault({x:[4]});
directTupleDefault({x:[4,5]});
